description: Retrieve the timeline of stages and jobs for a pipeline run, to reduce the amount of data returned, you can filter by state and result

pipelineId.description: Optional pipeline numeric ID for reference only

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project (Default: no default project)

result.description: Optional result filter (single value or array) applied to returned timeline records

state.description: Optional state filter (single value or array) applied to returned timeline records

timelineId.description: Optional timeline identifier to select a specific timeline record

name: pipeline_timeline
